exposure: sonographically measured lower uterine scar thickness
cohort: 150 female patients with singleton pregnancy, history of previous single cesarean section, vertex presentation, and gestational age 36-40 weeks, presenting to the Obstetrics department of Creek General Hospital from August 2021 to January 2022.
finding: Sonographically measured lower uterine scar thickness is a solid predictor for scar defect in women with previous cesarean section.
